newsitem.title: THAILAND: Seamico issues shares to Marlin affiliate.
newsitem.headline: Seamico issues shares to Marlin affiliate.

text.p: Thai broker Seamico Securities said on Monday it had decided to issue 411,428 new shares at 10 baht par to Raffles Nominee Holding Ltd.

Seamico said in a filing to the stock exchange that its shares would be exchanged for 3,247 B and C shares of Raffles Nominee Holding Ltd, a shareholder in stockbroker Marlin Partners Jersey Ltd, which Seamico agreed to acquire in October 1995.
The latest issue does not affect the Seamico's previous agreement to issue 4.5 million shares to the shareholders of Marlin Partners Jersey as part of the acquisition.
Marlin partners are active on the London market.
